set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces [interface_name].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface_name]` creates or selects a specific network interface in Junos OS for configuration or modification.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured.

unit [unit_number] family [family_type].explanation: Configures an interface with a specific IP address and subnet mask under a particular family type.

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration.

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface configuration (e.g., inet for IPv4).

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask in CIDR notation.

set protocols mpls interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set interfaces [interface].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface]` in Junos configures a specific network interface, allowing further settings like IP address, VLAN, or MTU to be applied.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured

unit [unit] family [family] address [add.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family, and IP address

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The protocol family (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and prefix length (e.g., 192.168.4.4/32)

set protocols ldp interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ospf area [area_id].explanation: The command `set protocols ospf area [area_id]` configures an OSPF area with the specified `[area_id]` in the Junos OS routing protocol settings.

parameters.name: area_id
parameters.explanation: OSPF area identifier in dotted decimal format

interface [interface_name].explanation: Configure OSPF protocol to include an interface in a specific area

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: Name of the interface to be included in the OSPF area

interface [parameter2].explanation: Configure OSPF protocol settings for a specific area and interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured under the specified OSPF area
